source_query:
SELECT year,source,county_key,precinct_key,office,SUM(votes) votes
FROM vote_observations WHERE source='alabama_sos' AND ((year=2010 AND county_key='GENEVA') OR (year=2012 AND county_key='MORGAN'))
GROUP BY year,source,county_key,precinct_key,office
ORDER BY year,source,county_key,precinct_key,office
